conviction_note: 0 because the print is not confirmed for this window, and even if it lands here it is a statutory FY2026 annual financial report from a pre-revenue explorer. Its one balance-sheet number that matters (A$10.34m cash at 30 June 2026, 1.9 quarters of funding) went out in the Appendix 5B on 31 July. The going-concern material uncertainty has been in the accounts every year from FY2024 through the December 2025 half, and the company's own annual and half-year reports have moved the stock 0.0% and -1.96% over their windows. So there is nothing unpriced to rank.
bar: No street number exists: consensus.quarters is empty and nobody covers the name. The only bar is the company's own last statement, the 30 June 2026 Appendix 5B. It shows A$10,343k cash, A$5,494k of relevant quarterly outgoings, 1.9 estimated quarters of funding, and tranche 2 of the A$20m placement (A$10.8m at A$0.07) still to come (https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260731/pdf/0729kry462hjkw.pdf, lodged 2026-07-31 17:00). Because the bar is a company statement and not two agreeing estimates, any size here would be capped small anyway.
filer_type_check: quarterly_report_only is correct: the ASX record for 2024-2026 holds 11 Appendix 5B quarterly reports and no 4D or 4E. So the vendor's 2026-09-24 date cannot be a quarterly (the Sept-quarter 5B is due by 31 October; the last three landed 31 Oct, 31 Oct and 30 Jan). The only lodgement it can plausibly map to is the FY2026 Annual Report to Shareholders, due by 30 September 2026. Last year's annual report was lodged 2025-08-08 09:27 and the one before on 2024-09-30 16:33. I therefore hunted the annual report itself, with its going-concern note, loss and subsequent-events note, and the state of the A$10.8m tranche 2 it would describe, rather than EPS.
event_check: The ASX per-issuer archive for 2026 (https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/announcements.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=RML&timeframe=Y&year=2026) and the rolling one-month view, re-read 2026-09-23 06:5x UTC, show the last lodgement as 'Results of 2026 General Meeting' on 16/09/2026 11:49. There is no Notice of Results, no annual-report date notice and no trading halt. The FY2026 annual report has not yet been lodged; it is statutorily due by 30 September 2026. The vendor date of 24 Sept (echoed by TradingView and TipRanks, which share a calendar lineage and are not a company statement) is plausible but unconfirmed. On the issuer's own record it could as easily land on 25, 28, 29 or 30 Sept, and three of those four fall outside the one-session window. This is not a TRT-style phantom, since a statutory filing is coming within a week, but the date is not established.
session_check: amc per vendor, and consistent with the issuer's habit: every 5B since 2025-07-31 landed after the close (16:52-17:44), the H1 FY26 report landed 2026-03-16 16:57, and the 2024 annual report 2024-09-30 16:33. positioning_check: ASIC aggregate short 0.0503% of issued capital (1,290,794 shares) as of 2026-09-17, lag 3 sessions, down from 0.0744% on 2026-09-10 (-0.024pp, covering). At a 0.05% short there is effectively no short. Squeeze fuel and short-seller conviction are both nil, and the lean (-0.28) is almost entirely the 20-day run-up term. The run-up is itself an artefact: +7.1% over 20 days and -2.2% over 5 days describe the Nasdaq-debut spike from A$0.042 (8 Sept) to A$0.060 (10 Sept), which has fully round-tripped to A$0.045.

outside_window.finding: Tranche 2 of the April A$20m placement (154,100,000 shares at A$0.07 = A$10.787m, with 1:3 options at A$0.10) was approved at the 16 Sept 2026 GM. Five sessions later no Appendix 2A for those shares is on the ASX, and the stock trades at A$0.045, 36% below the A$0.07 the placees must pay. Only A$2.66m of 'subscriptions received' appears in the June-quarter 5B. If the annual report's subsequent-events note or a later 2A shows a shortfall, runway falls from roughly A$21m of stated potential cash to the A$10.3m base (1.9 quarters), which would be negative. But nothing I found says settlement has failed. Settlement a week after a GM is ordinary, and the placement was cornerstoned by Tribeca and L1 Capital. So this is unsized, and it resolves whenever the 2A lands, not by the print.

The Golden Gate drill program completed 11 Sept 2026 and assays were still being reported on 15 Sept ('Latest Gold Assays Extend Golden Gate Mineralisation'). Further assay releases are the actual price-moving flow for this name: 2026-09-09/10 Nasdaq debut +26%/+13% and 2025-10-28 discovery. They will land on their own timetable, not inside the annual report, and their sign cannot be known in advance.

baseline_tension: Nothing I found cuts either way. The lean (-0.28) is a run-up artefact of the Nasdaq-debut spike that has already round-tripped, the short register is empty, and an annual report restating a cash position disclosed in July gives the market nothing new, so agreeing or disagreeing with the lean has no content here.
